objective: Find structural weaknesses before scale-up or Provider contact; PASS-rate and forced 320-product completion are not the primary success criteria.

defect_disposition.finding: Generic Scope keyword discovery was too noisy for named collectible selection.

defect_disposition.remediation: 32 Scope probes + bounded concurrency/backoff; final request errors 0.

defect_disposition.finding: Candidate existence did not prove Emerging/Regional/Scarce/Liquidity/Edge semantics.
defect_disposition.remediation: Role-specific evidence contracts and terminal states implemented; actual market-activity evidence remains open.

defect_disposition.finding: Initial attention mapping had transport failures and semantic overreach risk.
defect_disposition.remediation: Retry/backoff fixed; 60/64 mapped, 59/64 historical; Attention != Demand != Transaction guard retained.

defect_disposition.finding: Direct Wikidata mapping returned 0/64 despite healthy transport.
defect_disposition.remediation: Wikipedia title mapping + langlinks; 60/64 mapped, 55/64 multi-region, 31/32 Scope coverage.

defect_disposition.finding: Public multi-language representation is not regional market demand; second independent family plus institution/release/venue evidence is still required.
defect_disposition.remediation: Build local institutional/release/venue evidence adapters and validate regional market component separately.

defect_disposition.finding: Scarcity, availability, activity, sold transaction, illiquidity and liquidity could be incorrectly substituted.
defect_disposition.remediation: Separate evidence classes and hard fail-closed guards merged.

defect_disposition.finding: Current rights-safe institutional topology has no transaction/activity roles; many Scopes lack verified sold/activity evidence.
defect_disposition.remediation: Use Scope-specific official/authenticated APIs where legally feasible and external licensed capability only for residual material Decision Utility gaps.

defect_disposition.finding: Verified sold data cannot be treated as universally provider-only; BrickLink demonstrates a credentialed Scope-specific sold-history path.
defect_disposition.remediation: Classify Provider necessity per Scope x Evidence Class x Rights x Decision Utility.

scope_depth_implications: Keep Dynamic Vertical architecture; Attention can be a strong self-collected component but needs independent activity confirmation before promotion.
Regional depth should split Public Representation from Regional Market Significance/Liquidity.
Market Activity/Sold History needs Scope-specific adapter topology rather than one universal market-data provider.
Scarcity and Liquidity must remain separate metrics with independent evidence and confidence.
Normalization Confidence must decline when market-activity depth differs materially across Scopes.

eight_category_stress_test.reason: Current evidence strongly validates attention/regional representation but verified market-activity depth is incomplete and uneven across Scopes; changing 8 Core Categories now would risk turning evidence coverage bias into taxonomy change.

diagnostic_exit.reason: 160 challenger sample cannot be defensibly qualified yet; forcing 320 would multiply known structural defects and contaminate the diagnostic.

next_execution: Regional independent family / local institution-release-venue adapter PoC
BrickLink credential and API Terms bounded preflight for construction_mechanical_sets
Scope-specific authenticated market-source discovery for remaining high-value Scopes
Re-terminalize 160 challenger slots using actual role evidence
Run targeted stress rerun before any full 320 expansion
Then quantify exact Provider ROI/dependency and request Program Owner authorization only for residual gaps
